description: How far along something is — as a bar or as a ring. One component, because a bar and a ring are one statement in two shapes: HTML makes the meaningful split elsewhere, between `<progress>` (work moving toward done) and `<meter>` (a value on a scale that does not move), and this system keeps that split as <Progress> and <Meter>.
